title: trackline upload, version 1
description: Everything a connected machine may send, and nothing else. An agent's reply travels only when the user agreed to share their conversation. Every object is closed: a field not listed here is refused by the CLI's builder and by the backend. File contents, diffs, tool arguments and evidence values have no field, on purpose. Command text has one field, sent only where the user turned it on at the computer.

replies.description: What the agent said when it finished a turn. Absent unless the user agreed to share their conversation.

live.description: What is happening in a turn before it ends. A session keeps only the latest of each kind.

projects.description: Which agents are set up in each connected project, so the dashboard can show one that has never reported.

id.description: Unique per reply, so a retried batch is never counted twice.

text.description: The agent's final message for the turn. Paths made relative, the home directory replaced, token shapes redacted.

request.description: What the user said in this turn, so a turn answered in words still shows it. Absent unless they agreed to share it. Cleaned like the text.

cut.description: True when the text was longer than its limit and is not all of it.

title.description: The name the agent gave this session, where it keeps one. Absent unless the user agreed to share their requests. Cleaned like the text.

name.description: What the tool calls this agent, where it has a name. Cleaned like the text.

model.description: The model that answered, where the tool records it.

kind.description: A message just sent, what the agent is saying as it works, waiting at the computer, or no longer waiting.

text.description: Absent unless the user agreed to share their conversation. Cleaned like a reply.

cli.description: The trackline release on the machine.

behind.description: Agents whose hooks are older than that release writes. trackline init in the project brings them up to date.

id.description: Unique per event, so a retried batch is never counted twice.

at.description: RFC 3339 time the action was seen.

id.description: Random, chosen at connect time. Not derived from the path.

name.description: The project folder's name only, never its full path.

request.description: What the user asked. Absent unless they agreed to share it. Token shapes are replaced with [redacted].

helper.description: The kind of short-lived agent that did this, when it was not the agent the person is talking to.

tool.description: The host's tool name, e.g. Write or Bash. Never its input.

paths.description: Relative to the project. Paths outside it are dropped, never sent.

commandUnderstood.description: For a command: whether trackline could read what it touches.

detail.description: The agent's own line about a command. Absent unless the user agreed to share their conversation. Cleaned like a reply.

command.description: The command itself. Absent unless the user turned it on at the computer for this project. Cleaned like a reply.
